about: ABC News (Australian Broadcasting Corporation): search news, read top stories by state edition, browse topics, sections, authors and article metadata from abc.net.au/news.

commands.summary: Keyword search across ABC News content (articles, video, audio) via the site's Algolia index

params.name: filters
params.description: Algolia filter expression. Empty means no filter. Read (articles): 'contentType:Article OR contentType:article OR contentType:Recipe OR contentType:recipe'. Watch: 'contentType:video'. Listen: 'conten

commands.summary: Homepage top stories for the national edition or a state edition

params.name: view
params.description: Edition: national, or a state/territory code such as nsw, vic, qld, wa, sa, tas, act, nt (national and nsw were recorded)

commands.summary: Paginated JSON list of stories for a topic, by the topic's internal documentId (e.g. 1450 = Climate Change)

params.name: documentId
params.description: Internal topic collection id (Climate Change = 1450). Found in the topic page's embedded data.

commands.summary: Latest stories on a topic page by topic slug (first page, server-rendered)

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic slug as in /news/topic/{slug}, e.g. climate-change

commands.summary: Story headlines from a news section page, e.g. justin (latest news), politics, world, business

params.name: section
params.description: Section slug: justin (Just In / latest), politics, world, business, health, science, environment, sport, ...

commands.summary: Article metadata (headline, description, dates, authors, keywords) from an article URL's date, slug and id

params.name: date
params.description: Date segment of the article URL, YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: slug
params.description: Slug segment of the article URL

commands.summary: Latest stories by an ABC reporter, from their profile page

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric author id from the profile URL

commands.summary: A-Z topics library: topics starting with a letter (links to /news/topic/{slug})

params.name: letter
params.description: Lowercase letter a-z, or 0-9 for numeric topics

commands.summary: A-Z location topics (places) starting with a letter
